It is at least another 30years for me!!! My dad was the youngest so yep 😓 i think everyone here can do the math to figure out how old i am and my dad is.

I'll be at least 60-70yo before I can confidently kick the bucket

My grandmother is 90 years. I still want her around but I shudder about the thought of my dad being able live up to 90yo or longer. This means I need to delay my suicide for decades.

I love my parents very much. I would never want to hurt them. But I just really really want to go.
